checks: Integration appends six unique new case IDs and preserves all original bank objects and old classification entries; validates 3 questions, minimum 400 facts characters, plans, representative score arithmetic and whole candidate authoring.

Staging requires original canonical bank/catalog SHA identities, rechecks captured snapshots against baseline, verifies each backup SHA, copies the existing ledger, appends only new verified/published transitions and checks the full existing entry prefix plus exactly 12 new transitions.

Final catalog helper independently checks same ordered set IDs and exact content except lifecycle fields, preserves all classification entries, rebinds only bank identity and compiles the official catalog.

Installation runs under publication lock with expected-current-byte guards. All backups must exist and hash-match before any write. Failure rollback only accepts current original/own-written identities and hash-verified existing backups.
Deployment checks the installed files before and after apply, pins the known project host and source SHA, passes all learning classifications and uses new output paths.

Independent verifier reads the active release before and after, exact source/public/private projections, classification lineage/topics and complete learning units, and rejects mismatches before completion is reported.
